[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Project = "",
    [string]$UnrealEditor = "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor.exe"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Project)) {
    $Project = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\p3.uproject"
}
$projectPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Project).Path
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $projectPath
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $UnrealEditor -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_UNREAL_EDITOR_MISSING path=$UnrealEditor action=install_or_point_to_UnrealEditor_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}
$editorPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $UnrealEditor).Path

# UE 5.8 Build.bat uses %TMP% for its global lock path. MCP/noninteractive shells can
# have TEMP set while TMP is empty, which makes the batch wrapper report a false
# "Build.bat is already running" loop. Normalize TMP before Unreal starts.
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:TMP)) {
    $env:TMP = $env:TEMP
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:TMP)) {
    throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_TMP_UNAVAILABLE"
}
Write-Host ("P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_TMP_READY path={0}" -f $env:TMP)
$mapFile = Join-Path $projectRoot "Content\V2\Maps\Lvl_V2ProductionWorld.umap"
$moduleBinary = Join-Path $projectRoot "Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-p3.dll"
$hydrator = Join-Path $projectRoot "scripts\ci\control\Invoke-P3NarrowLfsHydration.ps1"

function Test-P3HumanLaunchLfsPointer {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return $false }
    $stream = [IO.File]::OpenRead($Path)
    try {
        $length = [Math]::Min(128, [int]$stream.Length)
        if ($length -le 0) { return $false }
        $buffer = New-Object byte[] $length
        [void]$stream.Read($buffer, 0, $length)
        $prefix = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($buffer)
        return $prefix.StartsWith('version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1')
    }
    finally { $stream.Dispose() }
}

function Get-P3HumanLaunchTrackedContent {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Root)

    # #941 player-facing runtime surface. Keep this bounded to content that the normal
    # Lane War launch is expected to exercise: production map + WP cells, base art,
    # input/characters, creeps/flying creatures, spells/meteor and environment dressing.
    $pathspecs = @(
        'Content/V2/Maps/Lvl_V2ProductionWorld.umap',
        'Content/__ExternalActors__/V2/Maps/Lvl_V2ProductionWorld/**',
        'Content/__ExternalObjects__/V2/Maps/Lvl_V2ProductionWorld/**',
        'Content/Generated/TowerAlignment20260810/BaseFringeCleanupCandidateV2/tower_parts_aligned_base_fringe_clean_v2/**',
        'Content/Building/Mechanics15/StiltHut/**',
        'Content/Building/Mechanics15/WeatheredWoodWallBrace/**',
        'Content/Building/Mechanics15/WeatheredRuneBridge/**',
        'Content/V2/*.uasset',
        'Content/V2/Input/**',
        'Content/V2/Animation/**',
        'Content/V2/Combat/**',
        'Content/V2/Flight/**',
        'Content/Input/**',
        'Content/Variant_Combat/Input/**',
        'Content/Variant_Platforming/Input/**',
        'Content/V2/Characters/GPT5/Sealdiver/**',
        'Content/V2/Characters/GPT5/Fennec/**',
        'Content/V2/Characters/GPT5/Raincoat/**',
        'Content/Tiny3D/33556cd91070d2797ab5d2570367c166f307a5a56d70abe42d3d2925934d0075/Canonical/asset/**',
        'Content/Tiny3D/c6e262a2a4600cf2c4a075f7a7db2fa4505297d2951fc7b369dc9def50ddb3ff/Canonical/asset/**',
        'Content/Tiny3D/245a1e11edaf8337d30023f798e3de1601901d488f34da5db8763cf1c5fc468e/**',
        'Content/Building/Mechanics15/BrutalistArchgate/**',
        'Content/LevelPrototyping/Meshes/SM_Cube.uasset',
        'Content/LevelPrototyping/Meshes/SM_Ramp.uasset',
        'Content/LevelPrototyping/Interactable/Target/Assets/SM_TargetBaseMesh.uasset',
        'Content/Showroom/Materials/MI_ShowroomGround.uasset',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/01_mossy_tree_stump/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/03_fern_clump_res512/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/04_lichen_boulder_res512/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/05_birch_log_res512/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/06_bracket_fungi_res512/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/07_red_mushroom_cluster_res512/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/08_pinecone_res512/**',
        'Content/Playable/Sealdiver/**',
        'Content/Generated/fennec_playable/**',
        'Content/Playable/JellyfishEnemy/**',
        'Content/Playable/Hummingbird/**',
        'Content/Playable/Eagle/**',
        'Content/V2/VFX/MeteoriteSpell/**',
        'Content/V2/VFX/GeneratedSpells/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/grass_*/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/sedge_*/**',
        'Content/Showroom/Static/reed_*/**'
    )

    $tracked = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    foreach ($pathspec in $pathspecs) {
        $rows = @(& git -C $Root ls-files -- $pathspec)
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_GIT_LS_FILES_FAILED pathspec=$pathspec exit=$LASTEXITCODE" }
        foreach ($row in $rows) {
            $relative = ([string]$row).Trim()
            if ($relative -and -not $tracked.Contains($relative)) { $tracked.Add($relative) }
        }
    }
    return @($tracked | Sort-Object -Unique)
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mapFile -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "V2_PRODUCTION_MAP_MISSING path=$mapFile action=restore_or_sync_the_V2_production_content_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $moduleBinary -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_EDITOR_BINARY_MISSING path=$moduleBinary action=build_the_p3_Editor_target_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hydrator -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_HYDRATOR_MISSING path=$hydrator action=sync_current_repo_scripts_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}

$requiredContent = @(Get-P3HumanLaunchTrackedContent -Root $projectRoot)
if ($requiredContent.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_REQUIRED_CONTENT_EMPTY action=sync_current_V2_product_content_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}
$pointerPaths = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
foreach ($relativePath in $requiredContent) {
    $fullPath = Join-Path $projectRoot ($relativePath -replace '/', '\')
    if (Test-P3HumanLaunchLfsPointer -Path $fullPath) { $pointerPaths.Add($relativePath) }
}

if ($pointerPaths.Count -gt 0) {
    $receipt = Join-Path $projectRoot ("Saved\P3LfsHydration\human-lanewar-" + [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.json')
    $oldRemoteFetch = $env:P3_LFS_REMOTE_FETCH
    try {
        # A human test must never silently turn into an LFS/network operation.
        # Local verified LFS objects are accepted; missing product content fails closed.
        $env:P3_LFS_REMOTE_FETCH = 'false'
        & $hydrator -ProjectRoot $projectRoot -Path @($pointerPaths) -ReceiptPath $receipt -MaxFiles 512 -MaxHydratedMB 4096 -InfrastructureBudgetSeconds 900
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_HYDRATION_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE action=fetch_required_LFS_content_into_the_local_cache_then_rerun_this_launcher" }
    }
    finally { $env:P3_LFS_REMOTE_FETCH = $oldRemoteFetch }
}

$remainingPointers = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
foreach ($relativePath in $requiredContent) {
    $fullPath = Join-Path $projectRoot ($relativePath -replace '/', '\')
    if (Test-P3HumanLaunchLfsPointer -Path $fullPath) { $remainingPointers.Add($relativePath) }
}
if ($remainingPointers.Count -gt 0) {
    throw "P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_REQUIRED_CONTENT_POINTERS_REMAIN count=$($remainingPointers.Count) first=$($remainingPointers[0]) action=fetch_required_LFS_content_into_the_local_cache_then_rerun_this_launcher"
}

Write-Host ("P3_HUMAN_LAUNCH_CONTENT_READY tracked={0} hydrated={1} pointers=0" -f $requiredContent.Count, $pointerPaths.Count)

$buildCommit = [string](& git -C $projectRoot rev-parse --short=12 HEAD 2>$null)
$buildCommit = $buildCommit.Trim()
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($buildCommit)) { $buildCommit = 'UNKNOWN' }
$moduleHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $moduleBinary -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.Substring(0, 12).ToLowerInvariant()
$runtimeDirtyLines = @(& git -C $projectRoot status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- Content Config p3.uproject 2>$null)
$runtimeDirty = if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $runtimeDirtyLines.Count -eq 0) { 'NO' } else { 'YES' }
Write-Host ("P3_V2_PLAYTEST_BUILD commit={0} binary_sha256={1} runtime_dirty={2}" -f $buildCommit, $moduleHash, $runtimeDirty)
if ($runtimeDirty -eq 'YES') {
    Write-Warning "P3_V2_PLAYTEST_RUNTIME_DIRTY tracked Content/Config differs from the checkout; friend play may not match until runtime edits are committed or restored."
}
$p3BuildId = if ($runtimeDirty -eq 'NO') { "$buildCommit-$moduleHash" } else { "DIRTY-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))" }
Write-Host ("P3_V2_PLAYTEST_BUILD_ID value={0}" -f $p3BuildId)
Write-Host ("BUILD MATCH CHECK: both PCs must show identical P3_V2_PLAYTEST_BUILD_ID value={0} before HOST LAN MATCH / JOIN LAN MATCH." -f $p3BuildId)

$arguments = @(
    "`"$projectPath`"",
    "/Game/V2/Maps/Lvl_V2ProductionWorld",
    "-game",
    "-log",
    "-windowed",
    "-ResX=1600",
    "-ResY=900",
    "-NoSplash",
    "-P3BuildId=$p3BuildId"
)

$process = Start-Process -FilePath $editorPath -ArgumentList $arguments -WorkingDirectory $projectRoot -PassThru
Write-Host ("P3_V2_PLAYTEST_STARTED PID={0} MAP=/Game/V2/Maps/Lvl_V2ProductionWorld" -f $process.Id)
Write-Host "SOLO PLAY: choose PLAY SOLO VS AI (RAINCOAT) for a standalone opponent match."

Write-Host ("JOIN RECOVERY: if no match appears, confirm matching commit {0}, binary {1}, and runtime_dirty=NO on both PCs; confirm the host chose HOST LAN MATCH, then retry JOIN LAN MATCH." -f $buildCommit, $moduleHash)
